package_signer.required_subject: Manifest Publisher must equal the real code signing certificate subject exactly; current CN=CADSG Native Runtime is a proposal, not an issued certificate.
package_signer.required_EKU: 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.3.3 Code Signing; digital signature key usage; valid time/chain; package SHA256 and timestamp.
package_signer.trust_scope: Already-trusted machine/system chain usable for the owner and native sandbox-account package registrations. A user-only trusted development certificate is not assumed sufficient.
permitted_final_options: Existing legitimate CA-trusted signing/deployment identity that needs no new local trust roots
Proper Store/managed enterprise distribution of this own runtime identity

admin_boundary: MSIX packages containing localSystem services require elevated package installation; no install/SCM/registry/protection changes performed.
